'''Lovakengj''' ({{IPAc-en|ˌ|l|oʊ|.|v|ə|.|ˈ|k|eɪ|n}} {{respell|loh|və|KAYN}}{{CiteText|text=Transcript:Rock_Golem#Lovakite variant|quote=Silly human, it's pronounced Lova-Kane.}}) is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of [[Great Kourend]], which resides in a volcanic area exclusively inhabited by [[dwarves]]. One of the three cities founded in the history of Great Kourend, Lovakengj was founded by [[Yonrith Lovakengj]],{{CitePostbag|issue=23|author=[[Lady Vulcana Lovakengj]]|letter=6|quote=Oh, Yonrith Lovakengj? He was our founder, you know. He was a great military commander, or so the story goes. Not much talent in Smithing though.}} the leader of a dwarven army allied with [[Saradomin]] that fought against the [[Zaros]]ians at [[Lassar]] during the [[God Wars]]. Today, the city is led by [[Lady Vulcana Lovakengj]] of the Lovakengj House.

As one of the five cities of Great Kourend, the city is responsible for providing military equipment for the [[Shayzien Army]]; their main export are ores found by blasting rocks with [[dynamite]] in the [[Blast Mine]], in addition to [[Shayzien armour]], which is made from [[lovakite bar|lovakite]], a unique metal found only within Lovakengj.

Since the establishment of trade routes between Great Kourend and the mainland, Lovakengj has established contact with the [[Consortium|Mining Consortium]] of [[Keldagrim]], though they offer nothing notable to Lovakengj.{{CitePostbag|issue=23|author=[[Lady Vulcana Lovakengj]]|letter=6|quote=Yes, we are in contact with the Mining Consortium. They don't have anything to offer us that we don't make here in Lovakengj.}} In the past, the city once had maintained contact with the [[imcando dwarves]] in the southern kingdom of [[Varlamore]], who reside in an [[Cam Torum|underground city]] beneath the [[Ralos' Rise]]. However, they lost contact with them centuries ago,{{CitePostbag|issue=23|author=[[Lady Vulcana Lovakengj]]|letter=6|quote=There are a few other dwarves in Varlamore, but we haven't been in contact for centuries, on account of all the assassinations and wars and such.}} presumably during the [[War of the Five Houses]].

==Transportation==
*[[Xeric's Talisman]] - Xeric's Inferno teleport (by the [[lovakite furnace]] south of the blast mine)
*[[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|CIS}} and run West 
*[[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] - [[Jewellery of Jubilation]] teleport (requires completion of [[The Forsaken Tower]])
*[[Games necklace]] - Wintertodt teleport and run south-west
*[[Fairy ring]] - {{Fairycode|DJR}} and run north
*[[Lovakengj Minecart Network]]

==Features==
===Sulphur mine===
{{main|Sulphur mine}}

The Sulphur mine is located in the north-western section of Lovakengj. Volcanic sulphur deposits are found here. Breathing filters like the [[gas mask]] or [[facemask]] must be equipped to reduce damage taken from toxic gases in the mine.

===Lovakite mine===
{{main|Lovakite mine}}
The lovakite mine is located south of the sulphur mine and is the only place where [[lovakite ore]] can be obtained. A [[Lovakengj mine bank|bank]] can be found within the mine, making it a good place to mine coal.

===Lovakengj Bank===
{{main|Lovakengj bank}}

===Lovakengj mine===
{{main|Lovakengj mine}}

The Lovakengj mine is a small mine found north-west of the southern [[Lovakengj bank|bank]]. Four [[iron rocks]], six [[coal rocks]], and one [[mithril rock]] can be found here.

===Blast mine===
{{main|Blast mine}}

The blast mine at the north of Lovakengj is the location of the blast mining minigame, which requires 43 Mining. It is run by [[operator]]s who clean the player's [[blasted ore]], returning ore based on the player's Mining level.

==Favour (historical)==
Prior to [[Update:Children of the Sun|an update]] on [[10 January]] [[2024]], [[favour]] was a core mechanic of each city on [[Kourend]]. Historical information about gaining favour and its benefits are documented [[Lovakengj/Historical|here]].

==Trivia==
*Lovakengj was named by [[Mod Reach]] "emulating what the Dungeoneering boss team did" by whacking the keyboard and making a pronouncable name, then afterwards adding the letter J because "Why not?"{{CiteGeneral|url=https://clips.twitch.tv/ImpartialTolerantWhaleDAESuppy|title=Origin of the name Lovakengj|author=Dan|date=29 January 2020}}
*{{Wp|Burning Man}} is an annual event held in the Nevada desert. The fire pit is a reference to the Darvaza gas crater in Turkmenistan.
